task_title: Node bus worker must consume the scheduler's text_b64 directive encoding
task_criteria: The in-repo node executes a dispatch that carries text_b64. Re-runnable at the graded commit from the repo root: (1) python3 tests/test_bus_dispatch_encoding.py exits 0 and prints arm rows proving a text_b64 dispatch is decoded and handed to the harness verbatim, a legacy text dispatch still runs, a corrupt text_b64 is refused by name (status refused), and a dispatch with no instruction is still refused as brief; (2) grep -c text_b64 scripts/node-bus-worker.py is at least 2 and grep -c text_b64 specs/ENVELOPE.md is at least 3, so the spec states the encoding rule instead of leaving text undefined; (3) bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and includes a numbered section that runs that fixture and a pre-fix red control against the worker source at revision 5b11bdc; (4) bash scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK. The live bus round trip is NOT part of this criterion (tracked by CF-365).
